253:       }
254:       for (const x of current) removeIndexes.add(x.index);
255:       decisions.push({ provider, row, next: null, current: current[0] });
256:     }
257:   }
258:   const fresh = await getCollection(env, false, deps.fetchImpl || fetch);
259:   assert(await sha(fresh) === beforeHash, "COLLECTION_CHANGED_BEFORE_REBIND");
260:   for (const d of decisions) {
261:     if (d.next) await setBinding(env, d.provider, d.row, d.next.root, d.next.meta, when);
262:     else await touchBinding(env, d.provider, when);
263:   }
264:   let duplicatesRemoved = 0;
265:   if (removeIndexes.size) {
266:     const next = before.filter((_, i) => !removeIndexes.has(i));
267:     const expectedRemoved = before.length - next.length;
268:     const prewrite = await getCollection(env, false, deps.fetchImpl || fetch);
269:     assert(await sha(prewrite) === beforeHash, "COLLECTION_CHANGED_BEFORE_WRITE");
270:     await backupCollection(env, before, when);
271:     let setConfirmed = false, setError = null;
272:     try {
273:       const result = await stremio(env, "addonCollectionSet", { type: "AddonCollectionSet", addons: next }, deps.fetchImpl || fetch);
274:       setConfirmed = result === true || result?.success === true;
275:     } catch (e) {
276:       setError = e;
277:     }
278:     const after = await getCollection(env, false, deps.fetchImpl || fetch), afterHash = await sha(after), nextHash = await sha(next);
279:     if (afterHash === nextHash) {
280:       duplicatesRemoved = expectedRemoved;
281:       for (const def of Object.values(PROVIDERS)) assert(after.some((x) => x?.manifest?.id === def.wrapperId), "WRAPPER_REMOVED");
282:     } else if (afterHash === beforeHash) {
283:       errors.push("collection:" + (setError?.code || (!setConfirmed ? "COLLECTION_SET_NOT_CONFIRMED" : "LONG_VALUE")));
284:     } else {
285:       throw new BindError("COLLECTION_AMBIGUOUS_WRITE");
286:     }
287:   }
288:   await writeControllerState(env, when, { candidatesSeen, rebinds, duplicatesRemoved, ambiguous, errors });
289:   return { candidatesSeen, rebinds, duplicatesRemoved, ambiguous, errorCodes: [...new Set(errors)].slice(0, 20) };
290: }
291: __name(run, "run");
292: var worker = {
293:   async fetch() {
294:     return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Not found" }), { status: 404, headers: { "content-type": "application/json", "cache-control": "no-store" } });
295:   },
296:   async scheduled(controller, env, ctx) {
297:     const when = Number(controller?.scheduledTime || Date.now());
298:     const task = run(env, when).then((s) => console.log(JSON.stringify({ event: "stremio-addon-binding-controller", ...s }))).catch(async (e) => {
299:       const code = e?.code || "RUN_FAILED";
300:       try {
301:         await writeControllerState(env, when, { errors: [code] });
302:       } catch {
303:       }
304:       console.log(JSON.stringify({ event: "stremio-addon-binding-controller", error: code }));
305:       throw e;
306:     });
307:     ctx?.waitUntil ? ctx.waitUntil(task) : await task;
308:   }
309: };
310: export {
311:   BindError,
312:   PROVIDERS,
313:   backupCollection,
314:   worker as default,
315:   discover,
316:   encryptBackup,
317:   providerDescriptor,
318:   rollbackBinding,
319:   run,
320:   safeTransportRoot,
321:   validateRoot
322: };
